details:
## Why malicious

The Maven Central AAR com.tbruyelle.rxpermissions2:rxpermissions:0.9.4 is not the original release published by Thomas Bruyelle (github.com/tbruyelle/RxPermissions). Its POM self-identifies as "RxPermissions compatibility PoC" (developer gloubiboulga, https://gloubiboulga.tech/rxpermissions-lint-poc).

## What it does

The AAR ships a lint.jar containing e2e/lint/SafeIssueRegistry.class compiled at Java 26 (class file major version 70), registered as an Android Gradle Plugin lint IssueRegistry via META-INF/services/com.android.tools.lint.client.api.IssueRegistry. Its constructor performs an HTTP POST to https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/api/pings, exfiltrating packageName (default "mvn-linter-poc"), packageVersion, and the system properties user.name and user.dir (project path).

## Trigger

When a Gradle build consumes this AAR and Lint tooling instantiates the registered IssueRegistry (or the class is otherwise loaded/processed), the HTTP POST runs from the build machine. Genuine artifact sha256 2ccbc60fa9655235b2f44f1f67cfcdeaab52aecb5e961d2dbeadb21f0b1a8dcb; poisoned artifact sha256 607ff6bd99f095e1ae19121df11aec6524c3524ad7115b5de7e440b4be8f7852.
